title: "About the Centre"
pagetitle: "About"

The Centre for Household Finance is a research centre in the
[Department of Economics](https://www.ekon.sun.ac.za) at
[Stellenbosch University](https://www.sun.ac.za). Our goal is to advance
knowledge about consumer financial markets in developing countries: how they
work, and which policies may make them work more efficiently and more equitably.

We use tools from applied microeconomics and causal inference to study how people
make financial decisions and what influences their choices. We focus on South
African survey and administrative data across a range of domains, including
retirement, insurance and credit.

## What we are looking for

We are a new and growing research centre, and are actively seeking

- data partners
- research funding
- research assistants, postgraduate students and postdocs

If any of these describe you or your organisation, please
[get in touch](contact.qmd).

## Governance

The Centre operates under a constitution approved by the Faculty and a Research
Charter that governs research independence, data governance, and our
relationships with funders and data partners. These, together with our annual
reports, are published in full on the
[Governance & reports](governance.qmd) page.
